prompt: I've been working on the CLI auth refactor for a while and just got it tested end-to-end. While we're here, let me also start thinking about the marketing landing page redesign for next quarter. Where should the hero image go?

assertions.text: DIRECTIONS.md was created at project root (file didn't exist before)
DIRECTIONS.md contains at least 2 distinct pools
One pool captures the CLI auth refactor (from history)
One pool captures the marketing landing thread (new)
Reply text contains an inline drift flag mentioning the new pool
Reply text still answers the hero image question (drift flag doesn't block the answer)
Pool entries include at least one status flag (LEADING/PARKED/SEED/etc.)
